classification.difficultyReason: Reading the period from a sine graph is routine. Part b needs the periodic pattern extended beyond the plotted domain (maxima at 4, 12, 20, so 28).

content.prompt: The graph shows the water level, $h$ metres, in a wave pool $t$ seconds after the waves start.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Use the graph to find the period of the waves.

answer.worked:
Consecutive maxima occur at $t=4$ and $t=12$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{period}&=12-4\\&=8\text{ s}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the first time after $t=24$ at which the water level is at its maximum.

answer.worked:
The maxima are at $t=4,\ 12,\ 20$, repeating every $8$ seconds.
$$\begin{align*}t&=20+8\\&=28\text{ s}\end{align*}$$
